description: Illinois — PILOT (docs/MULTI_STATE.md §14). Only values verified from public sources are filled; anything not yet verified is empty and listed under `verify`, so the app degrades (setup says what is off) instead of guessing. ILSoy reviews before first deploy.
verify: identity.orgShort, prompts.reader, prompts.readerTitle — ILSoy to confirm house style and the reader role
identity.branding — ILSoy to supply the logo file (none shipped; the header shows no logo until then) and its colours (the ISA palette is used until then)
legislature.sessionNote — confirm the General Assembly calendar each session
markets.ams.cashReportId — the AMS Illinois daily cash-grain report id has to be probed on MARS before it is set
markets.weatherRegions — the crop-weather composite points and weights (Iowa's are Iowa-weighted, so none are inherited); the weather signal is off until set
legislature.congressionalDelegation — Illinois members on the ag-relevant committees (hearings carry no delegation note until set)
markets.ams.feedstuffTradeLoc — confirm AMS 3511 carries an Illinois trade location (the series stays empty if not)
registry — no Illinois entity seed yet; geo layers via scripts/fetch-geo.mjs, roster via scripts/fetch-incumbents.mjs
election.campaignFinance — off until counsel reviews the Illinois State Board of Elections data-use terms
